methodology: Repository references are derived from curated public AI and self-hosting lists plus a separate manually curated commercial-project catalog. Candidate records are metadata only, marked review_required, and are never installed or executed automatically.

sources.name: Open AI Developer Tools

sources.name: Commercial / open-core candidate review list
sources.purpose: Manually curated projects that have or may have paid cloud/enterprise services, open-source community code, source-available code, or open-source SDKs. License and pricing claims are deliberately marked for upstream verification.

sources.name: Awesome LLMOps Platforms
sources.purpose: Upstream discovery list for LLM gateways, observability, evaluation, guardrails, and prompt-management tools; its reported license/status metadata still requires per-project verification.

sources.name: Voice and media engine manifest

sources.purpose: Agent missions, required tool families, risk levels and approval policies.

sources.name: Workflow blueprint catalog
sources.purpose: Creator, YouTube, social, JARVIS, research, coding, RAG and business workflow templates.

sources.name: Model provider catalog
sources.purpose: Hosted and self-hosted model API/provider configuration references.

sources.name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
sources.purpose: Specialized local-first CLI/MCP for evidence-based reverse engineering of authorized applications and artifacts. MIT for REA-authored code; check third-party and proprietary-provider terms.

sources.name: REA MCP contracts and transport
sources.purpose: Authoritative REA MCP schemas, stdio/HTTP transport behavior, tool families, limits and security boundaries.

sources.name: REA security policy
sources.purpose: REA bridge authentication details and explicit warning that runtime analysis is not a sandbox.

classification_guide.reported_open_source_candidate: A project commonly documented as open-source; current component-level licenses and edition boundaries must still be verified.
classification_guide.source_available_or_restricted_terms: Source may be available under restrictions; do not assume it is OSI-approved open source.
classification_guide.unverified_open_source_or_source_availab: Discovery candidate only; license is unverified.
classification_guide.hosted_service_warning: An open-source client or server does not make the vendor's hosted API, model weights, datasets, or service terms open-source or free.
